name: Percussion
tooltip: Adds a decaying harmonic to the first note of each phrase
notes: upper manual only; cuts Upper 1' while on

name: Percussion Third
tooltip: Percussion on the third harmonic instead of the second

name: Percussion Slow
tooltip: Longer percussion decay

name: Percussion Soft
tooltip: Quieter percussion

name: Vibrato
tooltip: Scanner vibrato V1 to V3, or chorus C1 to C3 mixed with the dry sound

name: Vibrato Lower
tooltip: Sends the lower manual through the vibrato too

name: Leslie Fast
tooltip: Speeds the rotors up to tremolo; they ramp, they do not jump
notes: mod wheel (CC1) above half

name: Leslie Brake
tooltip: Stops both rotors where they are

name: Leslie
tooltip: Plays through the rotary speaker, or straight from the organ
notes: rotors keep turning while off

name: Mic Spread
tooltip: Angle between the two microphones on the horn: the stereo width

name: Drive
tooltip: Overdrives the preamp before the Leslie
notes: level-compensated (rule 5)

name: Key Click
tooltip: How sharply the key contacts switch on; more is a brighter click
notes: read at note-on

name: Leakage
tooltip: Faint bleed of other tonewheels into each key, like an older organ

name: Expression
tooltip: Swell pedal: louder and, into the preamp, more drive
notes: MIDI CC11; before the preamp

name: Output
tooltip: Output level of the instrument

name: Pedal Release

notes: read at note-off

name: Split Key
tooltip: Keys below this note on channel 1 play the lower manual
notes: 36 = no split; channel 2 always plays the lower manual

name: Pedal Split
tooltip: Keys below this note on channel 1 play the pedals
notes: 24 = no split; channel 3 always plays the pedals
